column2: [intro]
In this world where nothing's right,
Everyone's upset, ready to fight.
Each one thinks they've been betrayed,
Constantly, we're dismayed.
But I take it all in stride,
I prefer to laugh and hide.
Everyone has their way to cope,
For me, humor is the rope.
Words and actions, all offend,
We argue over things without end.
Everyone's sensitive, they see,
But I prefer to laugh with glee.
Cause I take it all in stride,
I prefer to laugh and hide.
Everyone has their way to cope,
For me, humor is the rope.
[ solo ]
So why get all worked up and stressed,
When we can just laugh and jest?
Each one finds a way to feel dismayed,
But I prefer to sing and be swayed.
[outro]
